headline: He Earned Too Much for Social Security Before His Layoff. This Little-Known Rule Could Still Unlock $16,800.
summary: Most workers laid off midyear assume a big salary already disqualifies them from Social Security, and that assumption quietly costs some of them months of benefits they were fully entitled to collect.
